subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw accept the narrow live owner-scoped orphan transcript fallback proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92261, or keep current main's fail-closed behavior until the broader private recall design lands?
rationale: The remaining fix changes when a session transcript hit without a combined-store entry can be surfaced, which is a transcript privacy boundary rather than a purely mechanical docs cleanup.

options.title: Land the narrow fallback
options.body: Accept PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92261 or an equivalent fix that keeps same-agent owner-scoped live hits while continuing to deny cross-agent and basename-only orphan hits.

options.title: Fold into broader recall work
options.body: Keep this issue open but require the remaining fix to be implemented through the broader private recall design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100140.

options.title: Document fail-closed limits
options.body: Decide that live orphan transcript hits without store metadata should remain hidden and close this bug only after documenting that limitation explicitly.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow fallback
recommendation.body: Accept PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92261 or an equivalent fix that keeps same-agent owner-scoped live hits while continuing to deny cross-agent and basename-only orphan hits.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the session visibility policy introduced in the #70761 area.
